title: 100,000+ items
text: Only the visible items and an overscan are in the DOM; offsets use typed arrays and binary search.

title: Fixed or measured heights
text: A fixed item height, or measured variable heights that keep the visible content anchored.

title: Listbox selection
text: Single or multiple selection with Shift ranges, Ctrl+A, type-ahead, and a roving tab stop.

title: Focus never lost
text: The focused item stays rendered while you scroll away, so keyboard users keep their place.

title: Lazy and infinite
text: aui-range-change reports the visible range; loadMore appends pages with a polite status.
